fused_findings: AgentCgroup's useful transferable mechanism is tool/effect-call-scoped resource measurement, not its upstream authority model.

AGENT_RESOURCE_HINT directly influences memory.high; memory:high maps to max and arbitrary memory:<N>g/m values are parsed without a canonical authority clamp. F2 must treat hints as untrusted candidate input only.
Upstream cgroup identity uses wrapper PID plus timestamp and is not F2 causal/effect identity. Any resource record must bind existing immutable F2 call/effect identity.
Exit code 137 is labeled OOM upstream, but exit 137 alone does not prove an OOM-killer cause. F2 must preserve candidate cause until corroborated by memory.events/kernel evidence.
Production wrapper suppresses many cgroup/log/cleanup failures; commands may execute with an instrumentation coverage gap. F2 needs explicit MEASURED/DEGRADED/UNKNOWN coverage state.
Shell JSONL serialization is not robust canonical evidence serialization; use typed JSON plus exact digests.
Full controller operation is privileged and Linux/kernel/eBPF dependent; this is too heavy for the current characterization need compared with standard cgroup-v2 measurement-first reuse.
Cgroup-v2 fallback does not produce a transactional applied-policy receipt and can mark protection active after unsuccessful writes; any future enforcement needs request/applied/observed separation.
BPF backend selection is based on executable presence; failed attach does not automatically retry the standard cgroup backend.

Daemon source calls blocking stdout.readline before memory-pressure polling/health checks despite a nonblocking comment; this remains a source-level risk until a separate E3 discriminator reproduces it.
Local no-root wrapper's reported memory.peak is max of the wrapper process VmRSS before/after child execution, not the child command's true peak, so local peak-memory accuracy is not established.
Several bash tests validate copied snippets/simulated values rather than production wrapper execution; the 14/14 headline is weak production acceptance evidence.
Live semantic-hint validation explicitly prompts low/high choices for example operations, so 5/5 is prompt-conditioned rather than proof of a general intrinsic resource predictor.
GPL-2.0 favors mechanism distillation/reimplementation unless a deliberate compatible dependency decision is made.

thin_f2_design.name: ResourceEnvelope
thin_f2_design.identity: keyed by existing immutable F2 call/invocation/effect identity; PID/time retained as metadata only
thin_f2_design.authority: resource hints never self-grant. Any future enforcement remains deterministic authority-owned, clamped and separately receipted.

counterhypotheses: Standard cgroup-v2 read-only telemetry may capture most useful characterization value without privileged eBPF enforcement.
Agent resource hints may be too weak/gameable for enforcement and may only justify candidate scheduling metadata.
Per-tool resource telemetry may add little beyond F2 aggregate telemetry; future ablation must prove unique localization value.
